content.title: 11/41 Villas and Network Works
summary: Eleven villas delivered within the Les Pastorales development in Staoueli, combining individual R+2 residences with VRD, exterior works, and refined finishes.
Staoueli shifts the portfolio to a more intimate scale: individual villas, private residential comfort, and exterior works designed for access and durability.
description: The 11 villas are situated within a 41-villa development and rely on a precise sequence of TCES, VRD, façade work, and exterior networks to create a finished residential setting.
Their R+2 scale lends the project a domestic character: balconies, guardrails, coatings, and access works are treated as integral to the overall residential identity.
content.authority: A villa development delivered with attention to the details that make individual housing feel complete: access, networks, façades, and carefully finished exterior spaces.
